deployments_detail.use: "LISA" (Lennar Internet Sales Agent, Salesforce Agentforce) answers questions/books tours/creates leads; Palantir+McKinsey AI/data platform

LISA, an AI agent built on Salesforce Agentforce and Data 360, engages homebuyers instantly, handles after-hours conversations, schedules tours, answers questions, and helps prioritize sales leads across the homebuying journey. [Salesforce (Agentforce, Data 360/Data Cloud, Einstein)]

Amazon SageMaker Lakehouse and SageMaker Unified Studio used to consolidate siloed data systems into a unified data foundation, accelerating analytics and AI delivery and home-delivery velocity (per SVP of Data & Analytics Lee Slezak). [AWS (Amazon SageMaker Lakehouse / Unified Studio)]
Real-time computer vision system that monitors construction sites for safety hazards and alerts management to unsafe conditions. [not disclosed]

Palantir Foundry deployed to transform business operations and technology delivery, scaling from pilot to production to unify data and operational applications across the enterprise (per CTO Scott Spradley). [Palantir (Foundry / AIP)]

Enterprise data warehouse in Azure (built with 3Cloud) with Power BI analytics, powering revenue/gross-margin reporting and machine-learning-assisted client lead conversion and inventory optimization. [Microsoft Azure (Azure SQL DW, Power BI); 3Cloud]
deployments_detail.value: $92M revenue increase; $650K cost savings; 18% improved lead conversion; 17% reduced standing inventory

deployments_detail.use: The 'Lennar Machine' — a proprietary AI-driven digital marketing and dynamic pricing platform that predicts demand, adjusts home prices to market conditions and inventory levels, and manages targeted absorption rates to drive order volume and deliveries. [Lennar (proprietary)]

AI-driven home design personalization: tools analyze buyer behavior, recommend upgrades in real time, and generate instant visual renderings / generative design configurations evaluated on cost, sustainability, and preferences. [not disclosed]

Adaptive Security AI-powered security awareness platform running phishing simulations that include voice AI (vishing) and visual deepfake attack simulations to train employees against GenAI-driven social engineering. [Adaptive Security]
